rationale: No existing Playwright/e2e coverage exists for the Health screen (ui/test/*.test.mjs are node:test unit tests against a plain-object DOM stub, not a browser). A dynamic Playwright suite was generated, following the pattern already used for EPMCDME-14511/14505 (static-server.mjs serving ui/ + a window.__TAURI__ invoke/listen stub), to drive the real index.html/renderer.js/health-controller.js/health-ui.js/doctor-parse.js/doctor-groups.js pipeline end to end in a real browser DOM.
